info.title: AeroFS API
info.description: Remote file manager REST API. All endpoints require session authentication except public share endpoints.

get.summary: Get system audit logs (Admin only)
List all available connections from database (scoped to user's permissions)

post.summary: Create a new connection with encrypted credential storage (Admin only, Fail-Closed Transactional)
Compress files into a ZIP or TAR.GZ archive

get.summary: List virtual directory contents inside an archive without full extraction

post.summary: Extract an archive into a target directory (Requires Create + Write permissions)
Extract specific selected entries from an archive into a destination directory (Requires Create + Write permissions)

get.summary: Stream or download a single entry directly from an archive
Recursive search files in a connection
Get a specific connection and its capabilities

put.summary: Update an existing connection (Admin only, with atomic hot-swap)

post.summary: Create a directory

get.summary: List files and directories in a given path for a connection with streaming and pagination support

post.summary: Create an empty file

delete.summary: Delete one or more files / directories with bounded concurrency (8 workers)

post.summary: Change permissions (CHMOD) of a file or directory

get.summary: Stream file content or download with HTTP Range support (206 Partial Content)

put.summary: Update file content with optimistic concurrency control (If-Match header)

post.summary: Copy an entry

get.summary: Get detailed metadata for a file or directory

post.summary: Complete and verify a direct pre-signed upload
Generate a pre-signed URL for direct browser-to-storage download
Generate a pre-signed URL for direct browser-to-storage upload
Rename an entry

get.summary: Get real disk and storage statistics for a connection (Zero-blocking via statvfs)

post.summary: Test connection connectivity

Streaming multipart upload — now owned by TransferEngine (Upload-as-Transfer)
Wire contract unchanged: POST /connections/{id}/files/upload -> {success,message}
Internally: HTTP handler (thin) → UploadApplicationService::execute_inline_stream → TransferEngine → VFS
Handler no longer knows staging/duplex/write_stream/rename — all via TransferPlan + service.
Admit a streaming upload and return a job-bound URL for its bytes.

put.summary:
Stream a previously admitted upload session. The client must use the job id
returned by `create_upload_session`; a second PUT is rejected.

get.summary: Fast liveness probe — always 200 as long as the process is alive
Readiness probe: 503 when starting or shutting down, 200 when fully running

200.description: Service is ready to handle traffic

get.summary: Get current typed system settings and filesystem paths

put.summary: Update system settings and filesystem paths (Admin only, Atomic Transactional)

get.summary: List shares with strict user ownership filter (Admins can view all)

post.summary: Create a new shared link for a file or directory

get.summary: Public access endpoint for downloading shared files without authentication
List all sync jobs

post.summary: Create a new sync job

get.summary: List operations for a sync job

post.summary: Resolve a conflict in a sync job

get.summary: List active and undismissed transfer jobs (scoped by user ownership and connection permissions)

post.summary: Queue a new transfer job with full source and destination authorization
Dismiss all finished transfer jobs for the authenticated user (persistent Clear)
Cancel an active transfer job (enforcing user ownership)
Dismiss a single transfer job from history (persistent)
Retry or resume an interrupted or failed transfer job

get.summary: List all items in trash

post.summary: Move one or more items to trash (soft delete)
Restore an item from trash back to its original location

delete.summary: Delete an item permanently from trash

get.summary: Get user preferences for currently authenticated user

put.summary: Update user preferences for currently authenticated user
